recipes.name: Soybean paste stew with scallops (Paeju-doenjang-jjigae)
ingredients: 1 large potato, peeled, cleaned, and cut into bite size chunks
1 cup worth peeled butternut squash (or zucchini), cut into chunks
⅓ cup doenjang (Korean fermented soybean paste)
8 ounces fresh scallops, cut into bite size pieces
instructions: Combine potato, squash, onion, garlic, green chili pepper, doenjang, and water in a pot. Cover and let cook for 10 minutes over medium high heat.
Add scallops and cook for 5 minutes over medium heat.
Add green onion and turn off the heat.
Reheat just before serving with rice, kimchi, and a few more side dishes.
